title: Prompted Identity Degrades Cooperation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.35928v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly mix models from several providers, yet exposing each agent's underlying model identity to its peers significantly impairs cooperation. We show that when agents are aware of each other's model family, the group splits into clusters, where agents prefer interacting with others carrying their same label, although nothing in the task rewards or asks for such a split. We argue that the label itself causes this split, which we define as $\textit{factionalism}$. We show and measure this phenomenon in two cooperative games and on a reasoning benchmark, with nine to twenty-five agents drawn from up to five open-weight model families. We further show that when the announced families are shuffled, or replaced by arbitrary labels, the factions still follow this information; when the label is removed, this behavior disappears. translated_title: 提示身份会降低多智能体大语言模型系统中的合作性
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统越来越多地混合使用来自多个提供商的模型，然而将每个智能体的底层模型身份暴露给其同伴会显著损害合作。我们证明，当智能体知晓彼此的模型家族时，群体会分裂成不同的聚类，智能体更倾向于与携带相同标签的其他智能体互动，尽管任务中没有任何内容奖励或要求这种分裂。我们认为标签本身导致了这种分裂，我们将其定义为“派系主义”（factionalism）。我们在两个合作游戏和一个推理基准上展示并测量了这一现象，实验使用了来自多达五个开源权重模型家族的九到二十五个智能体。我们进一步证明，当公布的模型家族被打乱或替换为任意标签时，派系仍然会跟随这些标签信息；而当标签被移除时，这种行为就会消失。在严格合作的任务中，带有标签的群体平均多花费30%的轮数。
tldr: 该论文发现，在多智能体大语言模型系统中，当智能体知晓彼此的模型身份标签时，会自发形成“派系主义”，即偏好与同标签智能体合作，导致合作效率显著下降，而移除标签即可完全消除这种行为。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that exposing model identity labels to agents in multi-agent LLM systems induces "factionalism"—agents cluster and prefer same-label peers, degrading cooperation by up to 30%—and that simply removing the labels eliminates this behavior.
